title: T11: npm publish 0.0.1 and trusted publishing
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T11. Confirm @ml-lints scope availability FIRST. npm has no PyPI-style pending publisher, so publish with a short-lived token then configure OIDC.
acceptance_criteria: npm i @ml-lints/eslint-plugin in a scratch project lints a .ts file, reports @ml-lints/ML500 with a resolving doc URL. Tarball contains the vendored spelling map.

title: T9: Dual-language doc and README generation
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T9. Generators read the two committed manifests. Stays Python so just docs-rules never requires node.
acceptance_criteria: When only one language implements a code, omit language headings and render today's layout: 17 of 19 doc files byte-identical.

title: T10: Node in CI and a non-mutating ci gate
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T10. Today CI cannot fail on formatting or doc drift; check-rules-docs is dead code.
acceptance_criteria: just ci fails on unformatted code, stale docs, drifted vendored data and manifest drift.

title: RV3: Review - conformance gate
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-review T8 from docs/typescript-port.md
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer confirms the gate bites on deliberately injected drift.

title: T8: Conformance test
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T8. Reads ONLY the two committed JSON files. Drift-checks category/summary/suggestion. Does NOT drift-check exemptions, examples, docUrl, rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Must demonstrably FAIL when a shared code's summary is altered in one manifest, and when a category is misspelt 'localization'. Failure messages quote both sides verbatim.

title: RV2: Review - example harness
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-review T7 from docs/typescript-port.md
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer confirms both falsification cases in T7 actually fail.

title: T7: TypeScript example-verification test
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T7. Port of the enforced self-describing contract. Bad examples use new Linter().verify() asserting >=1, NOT RuleTester (which demands exact counts).
acceptance_criteria: Must demonstrably FAIL when the plugin rule set is emptied, and when a badExample is edited to lint clean. A harness that cannot fail is the defect this task exists to prevent.

title: T6: TypeScript manifest emitter and explain bin
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T6.
acceptance_criteria: packages/ts/rule-manifest.json committed; npx @ml-lints/eslint-plugin explain ML500 works with no install.

title: T5: TypeScript ML500, naive
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T5. Map lookup over identifiers and comments, NO exemptions (that is K1).
acceptance_criteria: Flags 'const color = 1'; reports via meta.messages, not a hardcoded string.

title: T4: packages/ts skeleton
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T4. Rule ID is the bare code so RuleCreator generates the doc URL.
acceptance_criteria: npx eslint loads the plugin. Answer recorded on whether eslint-plugin-eslint-plugin objects to non-kebab rule names.

title: T3: Python manifest export
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T3. ml-lints --list-rules --format json.
acceptance_criteria: packages/py/rule-manifest.json committed and byte-stable across runs; --check fails on drift.

title: T2: shared/ directory, sync script and justfile wiring
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T2. shared/ is truth, vendored copies committed, sync_shared.py has --check.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-editing a vendored copy fails just ci. Fresh git clone runs the suite with no build step.

title: T1: Manifest JSON schema, Pydantic model and categories.json
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#T1.
acceptance_criteria: Rules sorted by code; indent=2, sort_keys=True, trailing newline (byte-stability makes --check work). Schema validates a hand-written ML500 example. Must survive 'what breaks when Rust is added'.

title: RV1: Design review - manifest schema
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-design-review on T1's schema.
acceptance_criteria: Verdict recorded before T3 and T6 encode the schema.

title: F2: ML500 raises on a missing or empty spelling map
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#F2. ml500_australian_english.py:56-60 assigns {} when absent, so a packaging regression yields zero violations silently.
acceptance_criteria: Missing map raises; test asserts len(spelling_map) > 1000; deleting the map makes the suite fail loudly.

title: F1: Lowercase the dead capitalised spelling-map keys
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#F1. 6 of 1763 keys are capitalised but lookups use .lower() - unreachable dead data.
acceptance_criteria: All keys lowercase; test asserts no key differs from its .lower(); ML500 now flags 'Americanize'.

title: RV0: Adversarial design review of the plan
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-design-review docs/typescript-port.md
acceptance_criteria: Verdict recorded. Framework-level findings resolved or explicitly accepted before F1/F2/T1/T4 begin.

title: E2: Tracer bullet
description: Naive ML500 driven through every layer end to end, ending at a real npm publish. See docs/typescript-port.md.

title: E1: Foundation
description: Two verified ML500 defects that must settle before a second implementation copies the behaviour. See docs/typescript-port.md.

title: E0: Design gate
description: Adversarial design review of docs/typescript-port.md before any implementation begins.

title: M3: scripts/ path audit
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#M3. scripts/ STAYS at root - generate_rule_docs.py:110 and generate_rules_table.py:44 resolve parent.parent for docs/ and README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Generators run from the repo root and write to the root docs/ and README.md. Both sys.path.insert hacks removed.

title: RV5: Review - monorepo move
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-review M2 from docs/typescript-port.md
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer independently confirms the S101 and coverage checks, rather than accepting a green suite as proof.

title: M2: Move the Python package into packages/py
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#M2. git mv src/ tests/ into packages/py/. Root becomes a uv virtual workspace, ruff config at root only.
acceptance_criteria: git diff -M --stat substantially renames. Must prove a deliberate S101 in src/ still fails ruff, and coverage still measures ml_lints rather than silently reporting nothing.

title: M1: Coverage floor and cache-reset fixture
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#M1. Safety net for M2, lands first. No coverage floor exists today, so a broken move silently drops coverage to 0% with CI green.
acceptance_criteria: --cov-fail-under set at current measured value minus two points; autouse fixture resets _SPELLING_MAP and _BASE_METHODS_CACHE; suite green across at least three random seeds.

title: K3: Publish 0.1.0
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#K3. Complete ML500 plus ML501.
acceptance_criteria: Published; docs show both languages for ML500 and ML501.

title: K2: TypeScript ML501
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#K2. Hacky pluralisation; 'skip docstrings' becomes 'skip JSDoc'.
acceptance_criteria: Catches 'version(s)'; ignores JSDoc.

title: RV4: Review - exemption set
description: HANDOFF: user runs /adversarial-review K1 from docs/typescript-port.md
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer confirms every exemption has a paired positive test and none is broader than specified.

title: K1: TypeScript ML500 exemption set
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#K1. Must NOT attempt Python's _BASE_METHODS_CACHE. Imported identifiers, member expressions, object-literal keys, JSX attributes, non-JSDoc strings.
acceptance_criteria: Each exemption has a paired positive test proving the rule still fires on the un-exempt form. An over-broad exemption silently guts ML500 without failing anything.

title: E3: Thicken
description: ML500 exemption set and ML501, then publish 0.1.0. See docs/typescript-port.md.

title: E4: Monorepo symmetry
description: Move the Python package into packages/py. Deliberately after the spine flies. See docs/typescript-port.md.

title: A2: Documentation
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#A2. Includes fixing GEMINI.md:40,44 which references a .pre-commit-config.yaml that does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone runs just setup-dev && just ci green with no manual steps.

title: A1: Language-aware rule scaffolding
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#A1. just new-rule ML150 [py|ts]. Used-code set is the union of committed manifests. Next-free is per-BLOCK not per-category (1xx hosts three categories).
acceptance_criteria: Scaffolding a code that exists in the other language prints its category, summary and suggestion so the author copies verbatim.

title: R3: Announce the tag-scheme change
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#R3. Tags become ml-lints-v0.14.0 instead of v0.13.0 - most user-visible break in the plan.
acceptance_criteria: README updated; change called out in release notes.

title: R2: Lockfile matrix and publish gating
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#R2. update-lockfile hardcodes a branch ref that changes under separate-pull-requests.
acceptance_criteria: Both packages' release PRs get lockfiles updated; publishing a Python release does not publish npm.

title: R1: release-please multi-package config
description: See docs/typescript-port.md#R1. Independent versions, separate-pull-requests: true.
acceptance_criteria: A throwaway feat: PR produces a correct proposed release PR, inspected before merging.

title: E5: Release automation
description: release-please multi-package config and publish gating. See docs/typescript-port.md.

title: E6: Authoring ergonomics
description: Language-aware rule scaffolding and documentation. See docs/typescript-port.md.
